title: Introducing Instant Pay by Bolto
summary: Companies can now pay global hires compliantly in real time, with same-day and next-day payouts in 190+ countries.
body_markdown:
The fastest way to pay workers globally is here.


Today we’re introducing Instant Pay by Bolto. Companies can now pay global hires compliantly in real time. That means same-day and next-day payouts, globally.


### What we shipped


- **Instant payouts in 190+ countries**
- **95% real-time settlement**
- **Bank, card, and crypto payments supported**


### Why we built it


The leading HR and payroll solutions today still run on payment systems that feel like a black box. You send money, and your workers are left wondering where it is and when it will arrive.


That’s not just a payments problem. It’s a trust problem between workers and employers.


Instant Pay closes that gap. Payments move in real time, so the people who did the work get paid when they expect to.


### Where this fits


This launch is another big step towards building the premier AI-native Global HR platform: recruiting, payroll, and HR in one system.


Work is global. Payments are now instant.


Bolto is for builders.


### Get started


If you have workers overseas and want same-day and next-day payments with Bolto, drop us a line atinfo@bolto.com . We’ll respond within minutes, just like our payments.
